text: Stewie! Look at this! My AI coding assistant just wrote four hundred lines of bloated garbage just to build a stupid date picker!
Because you are letting it drown in boilerplate, you obese simpleton! You need Ponytail—the lazy senior developer plugin for AI coding agents!
Wait, lazy? Why on earth would I want my AI assistant to be lazy?!

Because lazy means efficient, Peter! You show him fifty lines, he says nothing and deletes forty-nine of them! Look at these benchmarks—it slashes AI generated code by fifty-three percent and cuts token costs nearly in half!
Holy crap, Stewie! It literally deleted a three-hundred-line calendar package and replaced it with ten lines of native browser HTML!
Precisely! And unlike your half-baked brewery schemes, ninety-eight percent of risky logic ships with bulletproof tests. It works across twenty agents including Claude Code, Cursor, and Windsurf!
Hehehehe! Sweet! An AI tool that works as little as I do! How do I get it?!
Search DietrichGebert slash ponytail on GitHub and install it before you bankrupt us on API fees, you blithering ape!
